messages:
maria: Quick sync — decision needed for internal API shape around tenant routing + quotas.
ajay: TL;DR options?
kevin: Option A: gRPC internal-first, JSON externally via edge translator. Pros: typed contracts, small payloads, good streaming. Cons: translator complexity for rollout and telemetry.
sophia: Option B: REST/JSON everywhere. Pros: simplicity for client teams. Cons: versioning drift, missing streaming semantics.
maria: Main constraints: 1) need fine-grained per-tenant quota enforcement at gateway, 2) telemetry must include route-level and token-level labels, 3) gradual rollout with canary config changes.
ajay: For quotas we need token bucket counters close to the ingress. gRPC vs HTTP doesn't change that, but streaming complicates quota accounting (per-request vs per-stream tokens).
kevin: We could embed a tiny proto header for routing metadata in the/gateway request and keep body JSON: header: base64(proto) — minimizes translator logic.
sophia: Example header idea:
```
X-Rdwd-Meta: eyJ0ZW5hbnQiOiAidGVuYW50LTEyMyIsICJyb3V0ZSI6ICJtb2RlbC1wYXRoIn0=
```
Gateway decodes and enforces quotas + emits telemetry labels.
maria: Rollout UX: Console needs to show per-route acceptance rate for new header format and fallback counts. Also flag when translator drops fields.
kevin: Telemetry: emit both raw_request_scheme (grpc/http) and normalized_route. That lets us compare cost/latency across variants.
ajay: Migration plan suggestion: start with REST everywhere but add optional X-Rdwd-Meta proto header consumers can opt-in. After 2 weeks of stable opt-in, flip internal gRPC for teams that adopted header.
sophia: Ops question — how do we surface failed header decodes to devs without spamming SLO alerts?
ops-bot: deploy-check: header-decode-errors spike > 5/min -> page on-call.
maria: We should instead log errors to dev-level stream and increment a metric we display in console. Page only on high-rate gateway failure.
kevin: I can draft a lightweight proto for the header and a small middleware lib for clients.
ajay: +1, let's run a quick spike. If Maria agrees we'll schedule a canary next Wed.
maria: Agreed. Kevin, please post spike PR and short README. Sophia/ops, add console panel for header adoption metric.
ajay: tagging @sophia for console work :+1:
kevin: will do.
